question: Which of the following types of DC motor is commonly used in electric traction applications such as trains and trams?
solution:
The correct answer is __DC Series Motor__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• DC Series Motor__ is commonly used in electric traction applications.
 
• It is preferred because of its high starting torque, which is essential for trains and trams.
 
• The series motor can handle large loads and operates efficiently under varying conditions.
 
• Its torque is proportional to the square of the armature current, making it ideal for applications requiring heavy-duty traction.
 
• The motor exhibits good speed control at varying loads, which is crucial for transportation systems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **DC Shunt Motor:**
 
 
• It has constant speed characteristics but lacks high starting torque, making it unsuitable for traction.
 
 
 
• **Permanent Magnet DC Motor:**
 
 
• Used for smaller applications and is not suitable for heavy-duty traction due to its limited torque capabilities.
 
 
 
• **DC Compound Motor:**
 
 
• Combines characteristics of both shunt and series motors but is less commonly used for traction compared to DC series motors.
